results.rationale: The small rod is removed from the hand; the faucet, sleeve, hand position and dark background remain matched. The removal is successful, but the stream still curves strongly rightward rather than returning to the vertical downward flow specified by the explanation. The edited hand and water are visually smooth and recognizable, without noticeable local removal artifacts.

The dark blue upholstery, wooden leg style and white setting remain, but the chaise extension is removed and the cushion arrangement changes to a two-seat loveseat. The object turns toward the viewer, yet stays oblique and lacks the three-seat, right-chaise structure in the front-view reference, creating major proportion and geometry errors. Independently, the resulting loveseat looks structurally sound with coherent fabric, seams and legs.
